description: Send the name filter of `GET /v1/project_automation` as `name`. The spec names the query parameter `project_automation_name`, but observed live 2026-11-13 the hosted API refuses it with 400 text/plain `Error: Extraneous key "project_automation_name" at path []`, while `?name=distilled-test-auto-a` returns 200 with only that automation out of two in the project. The member keeps its name, so callers still pass `project_automation_name`.
